upstreamPrimarySources.description: Node issue opened September28,2026 reports Node24/V813.6 worker-lifecycle WebAssembly failure with the identical allocation-erasure assertion and code-reclamation/tiering stack. The issue reporter links an upstream V8 fix and reports a patched-vs-unpatched experiment.
Official V8 change updates dying shared import-wrapper references atomically to prevent a code object being freed twice during reclamation.

inference: Our exact fatal signature, mapped stack, runtime family and repeated worker/Wasm lifecycle strongly match the upstream report. This is an evidence-based match, not a demonstrated installation of that fix or a verified engine patch. No OOM or workload-concurrency cause is established.
preservedCurrentState: The corrected code passed its game assertions in the bounded matrix and prior complete runs, but its most recent combined boundary-regeneration run aborted in V8. That failed report has not been overwritten or reclassified here. Release review remains required.
